question: Within the frozen historical A1 proposal plus public causal simulation family, which configuration gives the best accuracy that generalizes across Pile/LoRA-like and Finance/historical-like public development trajectories, and what cost does it require?

scope_boundary.literal_continuous_exhaustion: impossible because real-valued thresholds form an infinite set
scope_boundary.meaning_of_exhaustive: the complete Cartesian product of the discrete mechanisms, budgets, schedules, frozen empirical-quantile gates, exact anchor thresholds, and terminal actions below
scope_boundary.proposal_changes: forbidden; use the pinned historical public A1 affine lens and its stable top-512 ordering

pile.records: the 32 public development records already fixed in experiments/TRR-0001/plan.json and materialized under outputs/TRR-0002/public-calibration

finance.selection: take the first 32 nonempty user/assistant rows at or after raw cursor 38978, use the historical 06 Aug 2026 Llama chat template, truncate/right-pad to 128, and record every raw index and content/token hash
finance.overlap_check: selected raw indices must be outside the historical cursor and selected normalized row-content hashes must not occur in the historical cursor
finance.conditions: apply the exact already-frozen public_base and public_lora_2601/2602/2603 states used for Pile; do not train a finance-specific update

roles.surface_fit: records 0-15 in both domains under public_base and public_lora_2601
roles.causal_selection: records 16-31 in both domains under public_lora_2602
roles.held_out_confirmation: all 32 records in both domains under public_lora_2603; unavailable until after the winner is frozen and never used to revise it

proposal.ordering: score descending; token ID ascending for exact score ties
proposal.confidence: top-one softmax probability over the full vocabulary

search_space.fixed_policies: every budget in the grid for direct cosine; every budget except K=1 for group-centered cosine; crossed with every immediate-A1 mode
search_space.adaptive_schedules: every strictly increasing subsequence of the adaptive grid having at least two stages (502 schedules)

score_rules.direct_cosine: cosine between each public-prefix candidate simulation and the observed activation
score_rules.group_centered_cosine: subtract the mean candidate simulation at the current cumulative K from both candidates and target, then use cosine

routing_signals.normalized_softmax_winner: K times the largest softmax probability among current candidate scores
routing_signals.rms_normalized_margin: raw margin divided by RMS deviation of current candidate scores from their mean

search_space.gate_fit: for each score rule, routing signal, and K, pool only surface-fit positions and compute the named empirical quantile; a policy uses the same quantile mode at every stage but its K-specific fitted numeric threshold
search_space.special_gate: absolute normalized-softmax threshold 2.0 is additionally crossed with every adaptive schedule, score rule, immediate-A1 mode, and terminal action so the historical A2 decision rule is represented exactly

terminal_actions.commit_last_winner: always commit the winner at the last scheduled K
terminal_actions.fallback_to_a1: if the last-stage gate fails, commit A1 rank one
terminal_actions.abstain_and_stop_suffix: if the last-stage gate fails, emit no token and stop the rest of that record

anchors.historical_strict: centered; A1>=0.999; schedule 32,128,512; normalized-softmax threshold 2.0; abstain and stop suffix
anchors.current_calibrated: direct; no immediate A1; schedule 32,64; expand when K32 RMS-normalized margin <=1.2544946670532227; commit K64 winner
anchors.fixed_cost_curve: both score rules at every valid fixed K with immediate A1 disabled

search_space.deduplication: policies with identical fully serialized decision rules are evaluated once

phase_1_truth_prefix_surface.purpose: exhaustively screen selector components without spending canonical data
phase_1_truth_prefix_surface.prefix: public truth prefix; explicitly diagnostic rather than a deployable reconstruction path
phase_1_truth_prefix_surface.simulation: simulate all 512 A1 candidates once per public fit position and derive exact winners and all three signals at every grid K for both score rules
phase_1_truth_prefix_surface.every_policy: evaluate every declared discrete policy on both public domains and report domain token accuracy, mean accuracy, exact records, selected K distribution, and logical candidate simulations
phase_1_truth_prefix_surface.raw_evidence: retain a compressed full policy table and score surfaces with byte counts and SHA-256; commit summaries and hashes

union: the best 12 policies by the phase-1 lexicographic rule
the best policy in each score-rule x routing-signal x terminal-action group (18 maximum)
the best fixed policy in each score-rule x immediate-A1 group (10 maximum)
the exact historical and current calibrated anchors
all 19 valid fixed-cost-curve controls with immediate A1 disabled
phase_1_lexicographic_rule: higher minimum token accuracy across Pile and Finance
higher mean token accuracy across the two domains
fewer logical candidate simulations per 1000 scored tokens
fewer stages, then lower maximum K, then serialized policy ID

phase_2_exact_causal_selection.data: public_lora_2602 records 16-31 in each domain only
phase_2_exact_causal_selection.execution: full left-to-right causal reconstruction with only BOS and previously reconstructed tokens in the public-prefix cache; batched wavefront scheduling changes runtime only
phase_2_exact_causal_selection.required_equivalence: the exact historical anchor must match the pinned native historical decision implementation on a synthetic preflight and the retained canonical reproduction before it can be used as a control
winner_rule: higher minimum token accuracy across Pile and Finance
higher minimum exact-record fraction, then higher mean exact-record fraction
lower synchronized selection seconds per 1000 scored tokens
lower peak CUDA memory, then fewer logical simulations per 1000 scored tokens
fewer stages, then lower maximum K, then serialized policy ID
phase_2_exact_causal_selection.freeze: commit the exact winner, numeric K-specific gates, public input hashes, code hashes, predictions, and causal-selection table before accessing public_lora_2603 or any fresh/canonical truth

post_freeze.public_held_out: run the frozen winner once on public_lora_2603 in both domains and do not revise it
post_freeze.fresh_blind: create a new 64x40 Pile/unavailable-LoRA selection excluding every prior evaluation and public-development record; freeze predictions before opening its truth
post_freeze.canonical_dual: register the winner as an active method and run the identical serialized policy on both canonical setups under research/DUAL_BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md
comparators: always A1 plus direct causal K64

cost_accounting: base and expansion selector seconds with CUDA synchronization
peak CUDA allocated/reserved bytes and process max RSS
complete commands, timestamps, environment, code/input/output hashes, and exit status
stopping_rule: stop after one winner is frozen, held-out/fresh/canonical confirmation is complete, the full method-by-canonical-setup matrix is reported, and no merge or TRR-0003 work has occurred
